name: CoastRs free snacks and weekly lunch vouchers (Gold Coast)
summary: Free weekly snacks and drinks in the student lounge and weekly lunch vouchers at SCU Gold Coast, with membership for $1 a year.
how: Join CoastRs online, then check the student lounge and What's On page.
catches: The Pantry: students can pre-register for a spot for $10 and choose 10 items.

evidence.quote: We stock the kitchen in the student lounge every week with snacks and drinks and provide weekly lunch vouchers
